raw:
@q query
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "be a junior QA tester on"
      role subject ?x
      role object "the mobile checkout squad"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "hire"
      role subject "Priyanka"
      role object ?x
      polarity affirmed
      role time ?t
    end
  end
  at "last month"
